headline: BrasilAgro Reports Q1 2027 EBITDA of R$95 Million on Farm Sale
summary: BrasilAgro posted an adjusted EBITDA of R$95 million for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, driven largely by a R$50 million contribution from the sale of Fazenda Rio do Meio.
why: BrasilAgro is an agricultural company operating large tracts of farmland in South America. Asset monetization through farm sales is a key recurring or non-recurring component of its business model.
